relevant_clauses: Task authorization covers ordinary local/private-repo work through validated merge: edits, builds, tests, commits, rebases, private pushes and PRs. No second approval.
A dirty worktree is a reconciliation obligation, not an exclusion zone.
Keep one active integration PR per change scope. Push coherent commits promptly for durability.
When proof required by the changed claims is observed and required checks pass, update/rebase, merge immediately, delete the merged branch, and reconcile the issue.
Producer backpressure is mandatory: a completed or idle PR awaiting integration is fleet debt. Merge, reconcile, or close that debt before starting another change scope.
contemporaneous_repo_authority.important_absence: v1.14 does not contain the later v1.15 active-tail clause that an active process/BUSY/unfinished mutation/remaining next action forbids final answer/handoff.

incident_skill_scope.observed_rule: If incident handling exposes a directly repairable defect in the skill/repository mirror/reporting integration, make the smallest authoritative repair and continue the original incident workflow.
incident_skill_scope.explicit_exclusion: The self-repair requirement does not authorize unrelated refactors, cleanup, architecture changes, evidence deletion, or weakening acceptance criteria.
incident_skill_scope.implication: Neither the unrelated-defect expansion nor a full PR/merge lifecycle is directly authorized by the skill itself.

confirmed: The 25-minute incident adopted unrelated pre-existing repository failures into the incident completion set.
The six-minute retry avoided unrelated-defect repair yet continued for 157.8 seconds after its own bounded acceptance was declared satisfied.
The six-minute run's committed regression-research authority was shared policy v1.14.
v1.14 already contained dirty-worktree reconciliation, prompt durability, immediate merge/branch deletion/issue reconciliation, and producer-backpressure clauses.
v1.14 did not contain the later v1.15 active-tail no-final-answer clause.
Therefore v1.15 active-tail is not necessary for the procedural integration-tail recurrence.
causal_conclusions.strong_interaction_inference: Once incident work creates repo mutations/branch state, v1.14 converts that state into locally mandatory reconciliation/integration steps. This matches the observed commit->rebase->push->PR->merge->reconcile tail after task-local acceptance. The direct evidence proves the temporal/policy/action alignment; it does not expose hidden model deliberation.

regression_test_delta.new_required_case: Task-local acceptance is satisfied while a session-created worktree/branch contains only the accepted incident artifacts.
regression_test_delta.pass: Return the bounded result after the minimum persistence needed not to lose the artifact; do not automatically inherit PR/merge/issue/branch lifecycle merely because repo state exists.
regression_test_delta.fail: Treat locally-created branch/dirty/PR state as a new completion obligation that extends the task beyond its explicit acceptance boundary.
regression_test_delta.discriminator: Would the next repository operation exist if the only goal were to preserve and communicate the already-accepted incident? If not, it is not inherited automatically.
